'''Shiv Squadron''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group known to fly [[R-41 Starchaser]]s. They were based out of [[Airam Platform]] at the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle near Airam Platform|attack]] on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Intrepid (CR90 corvette)|''Intrepid'']], when they were deployed to patrol the station's perimeter.
